title: Visual edit locks on cards
description: Raised in grilling (HANDOVER §4). An agent, or the CLI automatically on edit, marks a card as being edited; the mark lasts 1 minute after the last change and the UI shows it. Advisory, to reduce conflicts now that Q&A posts bump the card. Ties into diff-based reconciliation. Not designed yet: needs its own grilling (storage, who sets it, UI behavior).

acceptanceCriteria.text: CLI sets/refreshes the mark on edit; expires 1 minute after last change

thread.author: claude
thread.body: Where is the lock state stored: a field on the card file (bumps revision), a separate runtime file next to .agentboard.lock (never committed), or in-memory in the bridge only?

thread.author: claude
thread.body: Who sets it: only the CLI automatically on every write command, or can agents also take and release it explicitly (e.g. 'lock ID' / 'unlock ID') for longer edits?

thread.author: claude
thread.body: Is the lock advisory (UI warns, writes still allowed) or does it reject writes from other actors while held? What happens when a lock holder dies: just the 1-minute expiry?
